scenarios.title: An 'if a Dragon was beheld' condition looks at the Dragon as it was when beheld

setup.notes: B has exactly five lands. B is the active player in main1 with an empty stack.

decisions: B casts Llanowar Elves, tapping Forest.
A responds with Dispelling Exhale targeting Llanowar Elves, tapping both Islands; as its optional additional cost A beholds a Dragon by choosing Shivan Dragon on the battlefield.
B responds with Doom Blade targeting Shivan Dragon, tapping one Swamp and one Mountain.
Both players pass; Doom Blade resolves and Shivan Dragon is destroyed.
Both players pass; Dispelling Exhale resolves. B has one Swamp and one Mountain untapped and pays the unless-cost if B is able to.

variants.label: beheld
variants.expected: Shivan Dragon is in A's graveyard when Dispelling Exhale resolves, but a Dragon was beheld, so the unless-cost is {4}. B has only two untapped lands and cannot pay: Llanowar Elves is countered and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: not_beheld
variants.delta: A does not pay the optional behold cost when casting Dispelling Exhale.
variants.expected: No Dragon was beheld, so the unless-cost is {2}. B pays {2} with the untapped Swamp and Mountain and Llanowar Elves resolves onto the battlefield. Shivan Dragon is still destroyed by Doom Blade.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge reads the condition from Count$OptionalGenericCostPaid, which does not look at the Dragon at resolution; confirm the optional behold cost can be paid by choosing a battlefield Dragon.
